meta.title: Quick Input
meta.description: A Quick Input button above the composer with an upward-opening snippet popup, plus a settings page to add, edit, delete and search the snippets.

quickInput.intro: Maintain your quick-input candidates: pick one from the 【Quick Input】 button above the composer to insert it into the input box. Entries are stored on this machine and survive restarts.
quickInput.triggerTitle: Quick Input: pick a candidate to fill the input box
quickInput.popupHint: Maintain this list under Settings → Quick Input
quickInput.popupEmptyAll: No quick input yet — add one under Settings → Quick Input
quickInput.contentPlaceholder: e.g. Review the code below for potential bugs, edge cases, and improvements:
quickInput.empty: Nothing here yet — add one above.
quickInput.resetHint: Restore defaults overwrites the current list with the built-in example.
quickInput.resetUnavailable: The built-in example could not be read (host route unavailable); nothing was changed.
quickInput.loadFailed: Cannot read the quick-input document (host route unavailable); changes live in this page only.
quickInput.saveFailed: Save failed: changes were not written to the local data file.
